_source: Tests discovered on main before the 2026-09 reorganization (git worktree of main, unittest discovery per suite), with the old model names mapped to the current ones (opp->opp_v1, opp_hc->opp_hc_1, opp_aco->opp_aco_1) and tier normal->functional. opp_v5_1_mono did not exist then: its counts (52 functional = opp_v5_2_split's 53 minus the one test that needs a separate stage 1; 8 stress) were collected from its own tree when it was added (2026-09-21). Both opp_v5 stress suites were redesigned on 2026-09-23 (19 tests each; old-to-new numbering in meta.md). Regenerate with `python -m scripts.run_all --update-baseline` only when tests are added or removed on purpose. opp_hc_4/opp_aco_4 regenerated on 2026-09-29: #17 added the 67 test_v5eq__* functional tests (130 each) and #19 removed their legacy stress tests (19 each, the v5 ports).

functional/opp_v3.note: test_bridge_earliness_order_size: numeric-precision assertion, fails identically on main

functional/opp_v2.note: test_bridge_earliness_order_size: same big-M precision assertion as opp_v3 (1.2e+21 not <= 1e-06); fails identically on main

functional/opp_v1.note: test_3_orders_1_mission_1_picker (test_case_15, was test_opp_model_15): the output graph differs from the expected one; fails identically on main. The whole opp_v1 suite takes ~8 min (real SCIP solves).

functional/opp_v5_1_mono.note: test_two_possible_routes (test_case_06): the monolithic model chose a non-shortest route (R_b_time=7.5 vs 4.0) that is equally optimal (obj_val=30.0). The test asserts the specific arc graph of the shortest route; the split model always returns it from stage 1.
